newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end steady, focus on Modelo.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end steady, focus on Modelo.

text.p: 1710 GMT - Portuguese shares ended calm in light trade with attention focused on hypermarkets group Modelo Continente, a unit of Sonae Investimentos, and ship repairer Lisnave. Dealers expected Monday to be a quiet session as the market continued to digest first half results.
* PSI-20 index down 0.11 pct to 4,766.57 points

* Trade in Modelo was probably an internal share restructuring before Sonae Investimentos splits off its industrial interests, dealers said. Modelo closed down 12 escudos to 4,438 in volume of 157,579 shares.
* Dealers noted some speculative trade in Lisnave, which closed up 11 escudos to 408 in volume of 154,883 shares.
